speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the onset, duration, and specific nature of your right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and memory issues, and tell me if you have noticed any changes in your personality or behavior.

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bickerstaff-Brasfield variant of Bickerstaff's brainstem encephalitis (acute inflammatory demyelinating disease of the brainstem and limbic system).

I have received your report of the 1-week acute neurological decline and 6-month cognitive/behavioral changes. Given the rapid onset of hemiparesis and falls, I need to confirm if you have had any recent viral infections or immunization history before we proceed with MRI imaging of the brain and brainstem.
